title: 第1584章 决战第1583章 一道圣纹
lines: “本王管你是谁，都给我去死！”
洛九州愤怒了，他是上古时代的人物，拥有绝世恐怖的实力，他利用叶小北的身躯重生，拥有征战宇宙万域的雄心。
现在，竟然在一个小小的地球之上，遇到了这么大的阻碍，他如何能够不怒。
“黑暗风暴！”
天幕低垂，黑色的风云漫天，遮天蔽日，洛九州使出强大的神通，惊天动地，整个世界都仿佛陷入了黑暗之中。
无形的风暴，朝着叶欢袭来，毁灭天地，强大的力量，让众人心颤，恐惧。
众人惊悚万分。
这是神灵的手段，掌控了天地，随心所欲，无人可挡。
不需要再废话，叶欢身上的杀意冲霄，他双手握剑，左手是锈迹斑斑的铁剑，右手是赤血剑的残片，发出绝世力量，绝世恐怖！
双方交战，地动山摇，仿佛整个三界都受到了冲击，虚空蒸腾，大片的空间直接破碎。
百万强者，纷纷暴退，拉开了几十里的距离，有渡劫强者亲自出手，才能够勉强抵挡两人战斗的余波。
一道血红的圣纹，符文漫天，化作滔天的力量，这是绝世的异变，带来的圣纹之力难以想象。
但，洛九州已经迈入空寂境界！
“给我杀！”
叶欢气势爆发，他的实力，不断的提升，强大的能量，从他的体内爆发，直接突破一层层屏障。
入圣，渡劫，阴阳，生死，碎涅——
叶欢的实力，在不断攀登，那无尽的能量，恐怖无比，形成绝世神威，震动九天十地。
“这，这是什么，他怎么会——”
众人震动，激动万分，叶欢的实力突破太快，难以想象，这也太过恐怖了。
“小北！”
叶欢轻声呢喃，感受着体内迸发出来的能量。
那是，嗜血丹的力量。
他的体内，有着两颗猩红的珠子，一颗还十分稚嫩，但完好无损，一颗已经达成，但是近乎于破碎，十分残破。
两颗嗜血丹，在叶欢的体内，宛如双子星一般，迸发出绝世的力量。
两颗嗜血丹啊！
噬血体，在宇宙万域之中，已经是绝世罕见了。
除了叶小北之外，叶欢便没有听说过其他噬血体的存在了，现在，他居然一个人拥有了两颗嗜血丹！
逆天了！
“给本王去死！”
洛九州震怒，疯狂出手，强大的力量直接撕裂了空间，各种强大的神通猛然袭来。
叶欢冷漠至极。
双剑生辉，宛如宇宙之光，拥有大道之力，叶欢催动铁剑，赤血剑，使出空间法则之力，身上的洪荒异兽的鳞片化作了绝世护甲。
他的手中，拥有了天大的逆天宝物，要逆天改命，诛杀已经迈入空寂境界的洛九州！
content_en:
"I don't care who you are, you will die!"
Luo Jiuzhou was angry. He was a figure from the ancient times, possessing peerless and terrifying strength. He used Ye Xiaobei's body to be reborn and had the ambition to conquer the universe.
Now, on a small earth, he encountered such a big obstacle, how could he not be angry.
"Dark Storm!"
The sky was drooping, black wind and clouds filled the sky, covering the sky and the sun. Luo Jiuzhou used powerful magical powers, shocking the earth and the whole world, and the whole world seemed to be plunged into darkness.
The invisible storm struck towards Ye Huan, destroying the world and the earth. The powerful force made everyone tremble and fear.
Everyone was horrified.
This is the method of the gods, who control the heaven and earth, do whatever they want, and are unstoppable.
"Kill!"
There is no need to talk nonsense, Ye Huan's killing intent is soaring into the sky. He holds the sword with both hands, the left hand is a rusty iron sword, and the right hand is the fragment of the red blood sword, emitting peerless power and peerless terror!
The two sides fought, and the earth shook, as if the entire three realms were affected. The void steamed, and large areas of space were directly shattered.
Millions of strong men retreated violently, opening a distance of dozens of miles. Only the strong men who transcended the tribulation personally took action were able to barely withstand the aftermath of the battle between the two.
A blood-red holy pattern, with runes all over the sky, turned into overwhelming power. This was a peerless mutation, and the power of the holy pattern was unimaginable.
However, Luo Jiuzhou has entered the realm of emptiness and silence!
"Kill me!"
Ye Huan's momentum exploded. His strength continued to improve, and powerful energy erupted from his body, directly breaking through layers of barriers.
Becoming a saint, transcending tribulations, yin and yang, life and death, nirvana——
Ye Huan's strength is constantly climbing, and the endless energy is extremely terrifying, forming a peerless power that shakes the nine heavens and ten earth.
"This, what is this, how could he-"
Everyone was shocked and excited. Ye Huan's strength breakthrough was too fast and unimaginable. It was too terrifying.
"Xiao Bei!"
Ye Huan murmured softly, feeling the energy bursting out of his body.
That is, the power of Bloodthirsty Pill.
There are two scarlet beads in his body, one is still very immature but intact, and the other is mature but almost broken and very damaged.
The two bloodthirsty pills were like twin stars in Ye Huan's body, bursting out with peerless power.
Two bloodthirsty pills!
Hemophagocytosis is extremely rare in all realms of the universe.
Except for Ye Xiaobei, Ye Huan has never heard of the existence of other bloodthirsty bodies. Now, he actually owns two bloodthirsty pills!
Unbelievable!
"Die to this king!"
Luo Jiuzhou was furious and struck wildly. The powerful force directly tore the space apart, and various powerful magical powers suddenly attacked.
Ye Huan was extremely indifferent.
The two swords glowed like the light of the universe, possessing the power of the avenue. Ye Huan activated the iron sword and the red blood sword, using the power of the law of space. The scales of the ancient beasts on his body turned into peerless armor.
In his hands, he has a huge treasure that defies heaven. He wants to change his destiny against heaven and kill Luo Jiuzhou, who has entered the realm of Kongji!
